name: compare_stability
description: gippa compare: Jaccard overlap between runs of island genes, operon-flag pairs, enriched categories, called novel ORFs and ALT sites (GIPPA_SPEC.md §7.9.3; M9-22, ADR-0046). The table has no coordinate fields.

fields.name: run_a
fields.description: First run of the pair (label order)

fields.name: n_a
fields.description: Set size in run_a (NA when its table is absent)

fields.name: n_b
fields.description: Set size in run_b (NA when its table is absent)

fields.name: jaccard
fields.description: n_shared / size of the union; NA when both sets are empty or a table is absent
